data.title: Marco Rubio orders Iran delegation, including Araghchi, to leave US after talks stall | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The delegation included Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, Rubio's Iranian counterpart, who had been involved in indirect negotiations with the United States during his stay in New York.
